fields.description: How Overtime is decided. "Hours" uses the driver's actual worked hours per day against Daily Working Hours below - this is what the client's driver-contract sheet specifies. "Trips" uses the LMV/HMV daily trip counts instead, which is how the workflow document's prose describes it. The two sources disagree; switch this if the client confirms the trip-count rule.
fields.label: Overtime Basis

fields.description: A driver's standard working hours per day. Trips that take the driver past this total on a given day are marked Overtime.
fields.label: Daily Working Hours

fields.description: Light Motor Vehicle: maximum trips per day before extra legs count as Overtime.
fields.label: LMV Daily Trip Limit

fields.description: Heavy Motor Vehicle: maximum trips per day before extra legs count as Overtime.
fields.label: HMV Daily Trip Limit

fields.description: Alert Operations if a driver's trips for the day exceed this many driving hours.
fields.label: Fatigue Alert - Max Driving Hours/Day

fields.description: Send the driver a trip reminder this many minutes before the scheduled pickup.
fields.label: Trip Alert Lead Time (Minutes)

fields.description: If the driver has not accepted the trip within this window, escalate to In-charge and Operations.
fields.label: Driver Confirmation Window (Minutes)

fields.description: A Compliance Document is flagged "Expiring Soon" once its expiry date is within this many days.
fields.label: Compliance "Expiring Soon" Window (Days)

fields.description: Customer LPO / agreement expiry alert lead time.
fields.label: Contract Expiry Alert (Days)

fields.description: Block quotations priced below the calculated cost.
fields.label: Enforce Minimum Margin

fields.description: Default minimum margin used by Transport Rate Calculation when a Quotation does not specify its own.
fields.label: Default Minimum Margin %

fields.description: Block Trip creation (including generation from a Trip Schedule) unless the Trip's Project has a submitted Sales Order.
fields.label: Require Sales Order before Trip

fields.description: Item used for the vehicle-rental line when a Transport Rate Calculation creates its Quotation.
fields.label: Transport Service Item

fields.description: Add weekend and public-holiday charge lines to the Sales Invoice automatically, using the rates set on the Project. Switch off to have Accounts add them by hand instead.
fields.label: Auto-bill Weekend / Public Holiday Charges

fields.description: Item used for the weekend charge line on the Sales Invoice.
fields.label: Weekend Charge Item

fields.description: Item used for the public-holiday charge line on the Sales Invoice.
fields.label: Public Holiday Charge Item

fields.description: Whether the Project's weekend/public-holiday rate is charged once per day worked, or once per trip. The client's contract sheet quotes a single rate against a shift, which reads as per day - confirm with the client before the first live invoice.
fields.label: Weekend / Holiday Charge Basis

fields.description: A Trip Feedback with Overall Rating below this (out of 5) auto-escalates to management.
fields.label: Feedback Escalation Threshold (out of 5)

fields.description: A Driver is auto-blacklisted once their total black points (incidents + fines) reach this.
fields.label: Blacklist Threshold (Black Points)

fields.description: Black points auto-added to a driver's Driver Incident record when a Traffic Fine's responsibility is set to Driver.
fields.label: Black Points per Fine (Driver Responsibility)
Enable Scheduled Fine Sync
fields.description: Off by default. Even when on, a sync only runs against portals that are enabled and hold a valid written authorization.

fields.label: Fine Sync Time Limit (Minutes)
fields.description: How long one sync may spend fetching before it stops and reports what it covered. A fleet sweep is a browser page load per vehicle, so without a limit it can run for tens of minutes. Vehicles not reached are recorded as Skipped and the run is marked Completed with Errors - never Completed. Leave at 0 to use the 30-minute default; set -1 to remove the limit.

fields.label: Default Responsibility for Imported Fines
fields.description: Applied to fines imported from a portal. Company is the safe default: assigning a Driver automatically would feed the black-points and blacklisting chain from data nobody has reviewed.
